info.name: Arch Client Accounts Cash Flows API
Get data for a set of cash flows available to the user

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of cash flows to return

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of cash flows to skip before collecting results

params.name: holdingIds
params.description: Filter the output for cash flows belonging to holdings with ids in the provided argument

params.name: investingEntityIds
params.description: Filter the output for cash flows belonging to investing entities with ids in the provided argument

params.name: issuingEntityIds
params.description: Filter the output for cash flows belonging to issuing entities with ids in the provided argument

params.name: accountIds
params.description: Will filter the output to only include holdings relevant to one of the account ids in the provided argument

params.name: title
params.description: Filter the output for cash flows with a title that contains the provided value

params.name: types
params.description: Will filter the output to only include cash flows with one of the types in the provided argument

params.name: beforeDueAt
params.description: Filter the output for cash flows with a due time before the queried datetime.

params.name: afterDueAt
params.description: Filter the output for cash flows with a due time after the queried datetime.

params.name: beforeCompletedAt
params.description: Filter the output for cash flows with a completion date before the queried datetime.

params.name: afterCompletedAt
params.description: Filter the output for cash flows with a completion date after the queried datetime.

params.name: beforeCreatedAt
params.description: Filter the output for cash flows with a creation time before the queried datetime.

params.name: afterCreatedAt
params.description: Filter the output for cash flows with a creation time after the queried datetime.

params.name: includeAllocations
params.description: Whether to include data about allocations in the response.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of cash flows available to the user as determined by the user's access token.

info.name: Add a new cash flow to Arch. Assumes USD.

items.docs: Creates a new cash flow and returns the URL, if successful. Assumes the cash flow is in USD.

info.name: Get a specific cash flow by ID.

params.name: id
params.description: A specific cash flow to query

params.name: includeAllocations
params.description: Whether to include data about allocations in the response.

items.docs: Returns an object containing data for a specific cash flow.
